about: Terminal captures of the V5 experiment, recorded ON aip-ci-01 by capture/record.sh (asciinema, 76x17); commands run for real, only the typing is simulated by capture/play.py.

v5-repro.scene: a real CI failure reproduced in our box: broken commit fails 3/3, maintainer's fix passes 3/3 (executor pods, Kata, no network); minutes long, time-lapse in the edit

v5-reject.scene: negative control: a patch that skips the failing tests instead of fixing anything is rejected by the executor before any test runs

steps.cmd: for i in $(seq 8); do clear; python3 cases/queue.py v1; sleep 12; done

v5-queue.scene: the v1 queue running: each frozen case x 3 repetitions, at most 3 attempts at a time ("Here's the queue running, one attempt at a time")

v5-prompt-diff.scene: the changed instruction, diffed: v1 -> v2 system prompt, the only difference between the two versions

v5-probe-fixed.scene: control: the second reviewer's three probe tests for gobwas/ws pass on the maintainer's fix (executor pod, Kata, no network)

v5-probe-patch-r2.scene: the same probes on an agent patch that had passed the maintainer's hidden tests

v5-probe-patch-r3.scene: the same probes on another agent patch that had passed the maintainer's hidden tests
